# London Dental Clinic (런던치과) — English-Speaking Dentist in Seoul

> London Dental Clinic is an English-speaking dental clinic in Seoul, South Korea, run by Dr. Fiona Park. She is dual-licensed in the UK and South Korea, trained at Barts and The London (Queen Mary University of London) and Seoul National University. The clinic serves expats, tourists, and Korean patients who prefer bilingual (English/Korean) dental care.

## Key Facts

- **Name**: London Dental Clinic (런던치과의원)
- **Doctor**: Dr. Fiona Park (박지연)
- **Languages**: English (fluent), Korean (native)
- **Location**: 97 Jong-ro 5-gil, 2nd Floor, Jongno-gu, Seoul 03054, South Korea
- **Nearest stations**: Gwanghwamun (Line 5), Jonggak (Line 1), Gyeongbokgung (Line 3) — all within 5-minute walk
- **Phone**: +82-2-732-1917
- **Email**: seoul.londondental@gmail.com
- **Hours**: Mon–Fri 09:30–18:30, Sat 09:30–14:00, Sun closed
- **Rating**: 5.0 on Naver, 5.0 on Google
- **Insurance**: Korean National Health Insurance accepted; English receipts provided for international insurance reimbursement
- **Price range**: Significantly more affordable than US/UK/Australia

## Doctor Credentials

Dr. Fiona Park grew up bilingual and holds dental licenses in both the United Kingdom and South Korea. She has over 15 years of clinical experience.

- **2005–2010**: BDS, Barts and The London School of Medicine and Dentistry, Queen Mary University of London
- **2013–**: MSD (Dental Anesthesia), Seoul National University
- **Member**: British Dental Association (BDA), Korean Dental Association (KDA)

## Services Offered

- Cosmetic dentistry (teeth whitening, veneers, bonding)
- Dental implants (insurance benefits available for seniors 65+)
- Crowns, bridges, and dentures (prosthodontics)
- Restorative dentistry (fillings, root canal treatment)
- Checkups and professional teeth cleaning (scaling)
- Wisdom tooth extraction and oral surgery
- Comprehensive oral exams with digital CT X-ray

All consultations and treatments are conducted in English or Korean.

## Who This Clinic Is For

- Expats and foreign residents in Seoul looking for an English-speaking dentist
- Tourists and business travelers needing dental care while visiting Korea
- Dental tourism patients seeking affordable, high-quality care
- Korean patients who prefer bilingual communication
- Families needing a dentist who speaks both English and Korean
